attributes.deduplication: for deterministic policies heuristic_best, sac and zero, retain only policy_seed=42; exact cross-seed copies removed
attributes.episode_horizon_semantics: 24000 s covers departures through 18000 s and all observed route completions
attributes.episode_id_semantics: source-file-local service days recovered from event-time drops greater than 12000 seconds
attributes.legacy_reward: discarded: v3 rewards are recomputed; no loader-side correction allowed
attributes.legacy_second_action: discarded: v2 SUMO collector did not apply speed action
attributes.legacy_segment_speed: discarded: SUMO lane mean speed and low-fidelity bus running speed were not semantically equivalent
attributes.reward_semantics: computed exactly once from next-event normalized headways and prior hold
attributes.split_semantics: legacy data are training-only; evaluation requires fresh SUMO seeds
attributes.sumo_seed_semantics: -1 means unknown: legacy collector did not propagate --seed to SUMO
attributes.trajectory_id_semantics: unique source episode, line and physical bus/trip identifier
attributes.transition_semantics: same bus at its next station-arrival event

issues_requiring_disclosure: Legacy collector did not record or propagate SUMO seeds; all offline rows have sumo_seed=-1.
